SELECT
	P.Id id,
	P.ProductName sku_name,
	P.ProductCode sku_number,
	CASE WHEN P.ProductType = 1 AND P.IsMasterProduct = 1 THEN 5 WHEN P.ProductSubType = 8 THEN 6 ELSE P.ProductSubType END type_id,
	ISNULL(PPPB.FaceValueWithTax, PPVB.FaceValueWithTax) face_value_with_tax,
	NULL voucher_number_rule_id,
	'TXC' created_by,
	GETUTCDATE() created_datetime,
	NULL merchant_group_id,
	ISNULL(PPPB.FaceValue, PPVB.FaceValue) face_value_without_tax,
	PPPB.Balance multiplier
FROM Product P
INNER JOIN ProductVersion PV ON P.Id = PV.ProductId AND PV.IsCurrentVersion = 1
LEFT OUTER JOIN ProductPricingProductBased PPPB ON PV.ProductPricingProductBasedId = PPPB.Id
LEFT OUTER JOIN ProductPricingValueBased PPVB ON PV.ProductPricingValueBasedId = PPVB.Id

DECLARE @merchant_group_id INT
DECLARE @created_on DATETIME
DECLARE @next_value BIGINT
DECLARE @identity_code VARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @merchant_id INT

DECLARE C CURSOR FOR
SELECT merchant_group_id, created_on FROM merchant_info.tb_mg_merchant_group WHERE merchant_id IS NULL ORDER BY merchant_group_id

OPEN C;
FETCH NEXT FROM C INTO @merchant_group_id, @created_on

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	SELECT @next_value = NEXT VALUE FOR merchant_info.Seq_Merchant_Identity_Code
	SET @identity_code = RIGHT(REPLICATE(0,15) + CAST(@next_value AS VARCHAR), 15)
	--SET @identity_code = CAST(@tenant_id AS VARCHAR) + @identity_code

	INSERT INTO merchant_info.tb_m_merchant (program_id, address_id, identity_code, [name], mam_email, merchant_auto_type, modifier, [version], version_time, merchant_group_id)
	VALUES (0, 0, @identity_code, 'Merchant Group ' + CAST(@merchant_group_id AS VARCHAR), '', 0, 'Migration', 1, @created_on, @merchant_group_id)

	SET @merchant_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	UPDATE merchant_info.tb_mg_merchant_group SET merchant_id = @merchant_id
	WHERE merchant_group_id = @merchant_group_id

	FETCH NEXT FROM C INTO @merchant_group_id, @created_on
END

CLOSE C
DEALLOCATE C

ALTER TABLE merchant_info.tb_mg_merchant_group
ALTER COLUMN merchant_id INT NULL

ALTER TABLE merchant_info.tb_mg_merchant_group
ALTER COLUMN merchant_id INT NOT NULL

SELECT PM.ExternalId product_id, C.ExternalId acceptance_loop_id
FROM ProductVersion PV
INNER JOIN Product P ON PV.ProductId = P.Id
INNER JOIN TXCProductMapping PM ON P.Id = PM.ProductId
INNER JOIN AcceptanceLoopMigration M ON P.AcceptanceLoopId = M.AcceptanceLoopId
INNER JOIN AcceptanceLoopMigrationConsolidate C ON M.ConsolidateId = C.AcceptanceLoopId
WHERE PV.IsCurrentVersion = 1 AND C.ExternalId IS NOT NULL

FROM PRODUCT.tb_p_product P
WHERE product.tb_p_product_version.product_id = P.product_id

UPDATE merchant_info.tb_contract_sku SET merchant_group_id = AL.merchant_group_id
FROM merchant_info.tb_al_acceptance_loop AL,
product.tb_p_product P
WHERE merchant_info.tb_contract_sku.id = P.sku_id
AND AL.acceptance_loop_id = P.acceptance_loop_id

UPDATE merchant_info.tb_al_acceptance_loop SET
	code = m.identity_code + '_default',
	description = 'Default acceptance loop for ' + m.identity_code
FROM merchant_info.tb_mg_merchant_group mg,
merchant_info.tb_m_merchant m
WHERE merchant_info.tb_al_acceptance_loop.merchant_group_id = mg.merchant_group_id
AND mg.merchant_id = m.id
AND merchant_info.tb_al_acceptance_loop.is_default = 1
AND merchant_info.tb_al_acceptance_loop.merchant_group_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT
	MC.Id contract_id,
	M.IdentityCode + '_' + P.ProductCode contract_name,
	MC.ValidFrom start_date,
	MC.ValidTo end_date,
	3 payment_term_id,
	3 price_option_id,
	CASE WHEN P.ProductType = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END cost_scheme_id,
	CASE WHEN P.ProductType = 2 THEN RS.Value ELSE NULL END cost_percentage,
	1 cost_rounding_rule_id,
	1 cost_rounding_places_id,
	1 sku_quantity,
	3 status_id,
	MM.TXCMerchantId merchant_id,
	'TX2' created_by,
	MC.CreatedOn created_datetime,
	PM.ExternalId sku_id,
	RS.Value cost
FROM MerchantContract MC
INNER JOIN Merchant M ON MC.MerchantId = M.Id
INNER JOIN ProductVersion PV ON MC.ProductVersionId = pv.Id
INNER JOIN Product P ON PV.ProductId = P.Id
INNER JOIN ReimbursementScheme RS ON MC.Id = RS.MerchantContractId AND TransactionTypeId = (SELECT Id FROM Dictionary WHERE Category = 'TransactionType' AND Name = '101')
LEFT OUTER JOIN TXCMerchantMapping MM ON M.Id = MM.TX2MerchantId
LEFT OUTER JOIN TXCProductMapping PM ON P.Id = PM.ProductId
WHERE P.Id IN
(
	SELECT P.Id FROM Product P INNER JOIN ProductVersion PV ON P.Id = PV.ProductId AND PV.IsCurrentVersion = 1
)

SELECT DISTINCT
	MC.Id id,
	MC.Id contract_id,
	M.IdentityCode + '_' + P.ProductCode contract_name,
	MC.ValidFrom start_date,
	MC.ValidTo end_date,
	3 payment_term_id,
	3 price_option_id,
	CASE WHEN P.ProductType = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END cost_scheme_id,
	1 sku_quantity,
	2 status_id,
	MM.TXCMerchantId merchant_id,
	'TX2' created_by,
	MC.CreatedOn created_datetime,
	PM.ExternalId sku_id,
	RS.Value cost
FROM MerchantContract MC
INNER JOIN Merchant M ON MC.MerchantId = M.Id
INNER JOIN ProductVersion PV ON MC.ProductVersionId = pv.Id
INNER JOIN Product P ON PV.ProductId = P.Id
INNER JOIN ReimbursementScheme RS ON MC.Id = RS.MerchantContractId AND TransactionTypeId = (SELECT Id FROM Dictionary WHERE Category = 'TransactionType' AND Name = '101')
LEFT OUTER JOIN TXCMerchantMapping MM ON M.Id = MM.TX2MerchantId
LEFT OUTER JOIN TXCProductMapping PM ON P.Id = PM.ProductId
WHERE P.Id IN
(
	SELECT P.Id FROM Product P INNER JOIN ProductVersion PV ON P.Id = PV.ProductId AND PV.IsCurrentVersion = 1
)

BEGIN TRAN
BEGIN TRY

    DECLARE @merchant_id INT
    SELECT TOP 1 @merchant_id = id FROM merchant_info.tb_m_merchant WHERE name = 'Smart Choice Voucher' ORDER BY id

    INSERT INTO merchant_info.tb_contract (contract_name, start_date, end_date, payment_term_id, price_option_id, cost_scheme_id,
    cost_rounding_rule_id, cost_rounding_places_id, sku_quantity, status_id, merchant_id, created_by, created_datetime)
    VALUES ('Contract SCV', '2023/1/1', '2999/12/31', 1, 1, 2, 1, 3, 0, 3, @merchant_id, NULL, GETUTCDATE())

    INSERT INTO merchant_info.tb_contract (contract_name, start_date, end_date, payment_term_id, price_option_id, cost_scheme_id,
    cost_rounding_rule_id, cost_rounding_places_id, sku_quantity, status_id, merchant_id, created_by, created_datetime)
    VALUES ('Contract Super', '2023/1/1', '2999/12/31', 1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 3, @merchant_id, NULL, GETUTCDATE())

    INSERT INTO merchant_info.tb_contract_sku_cost (contract_id, sku_id, cost, valid_start_date, valid_end_date, status_id, created_by, created_datetime)
    SELECT C.id, S.id, 0.00, '2023/1/1', '2999/12/31', 2, 'Migration', GETUTCDATE()
    FROM merchant_info.tb_contract C
    CROSS JOIN merchant_info.tb_contract_sku S
    WHERE C.contract_name = 'Contract SCV'
    AND S.type_id = 5 --SCV

    INSERT INTO merchant_info.tb_contract_sku_cost (contract_id, sku_id, cost, valid_start_date, valid_end_date, status_id, created_by, created_datetime)
    SELECT C.id, S.id, 0.00, '2023/1/1', '2999/12/31', 2, 'Migration', GETUTCDATE()
    FROM merchant_info.tb_contract C
    CROSS JOIN merchant_info.tb_contract_sku S
    WHERE C.contract_name = 'Contract Super'
    AND S.type_id = 6 --SCV

    UPDATE merchant_info.tb_contract SET sku_quantity = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM merchant_info.tb_contract_sku_cost WHERE contract_id = (SELECT Id FROM merchant_info.tb_contract WHERE contract_name = 'Contract SCV'))
    WHERE contract_name = 'Contract SCV'

    UPDATE merchant_info.tb_contract SET sku_quantity = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM merchant_info.tb_contract_sku_cost WHERE contract_id = (SELECT Id FROM merchant_info.tb_contract WHERE contract_name = 'Contract Super'))
    WHERE contract_name = 'Contract Super'

    COMMIT TRAN;
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    ROLLBACK TRAN;
    THROW
END CATCH
